title: (2025 NOV) Cumulative Updates for Business Central
summary: Cumulative updates for Business Central replace previously released updates for each version and may include security vulnerability fixes. The post lists available updates for active versions (v27, v26, v25) and references versions no longer receiving updates.
key_points: Latest updates should always be installed as they may fix security vulnerabilities
Updates include both global hotfixes and localization-specific fixes
Active versions receiving updates are v27 (2025 Wave 2), v26 (2025 Wave 1), and v25 (2024 Wave 2)
Older versions from v24 backward are no longer updated and links are provided for historical reference

quotes.text: Some updates additionally fix vulnerabilities, so the latest update should always be installed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Emphasizes the security importance of keeping Business Central installations current with the latest cumulative updates
